cohort: The study included 5,216 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) of 4 public hospitals in Sidama Region, Ethiopia, over a 5-year period (2017-2022).
finding: The study found a high incidence of hospital-associated infections (HAIs) at 40% and unexpectedly high HAIs-related deaths in NICUs, with hospital type, place of delivery, antibiotic treatment, and low birth weight identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: Place of delivery was identified as a risk factor for hospital-associated infections.
